professionalSummary: Nine years of product management experience, including three years managing product managers, with current role as Group Product Manager for a SaaS developer platform since 2022.
Owner of API tier pricing and packaging in collaboration with the commercial team, having approved two tier changes in 2023 and 2024.
Responsible for setting the platform roadmap with the product director and conducting quarterly roadmap reviews with engineering leadership.
Coached three product managers under a documented coaching practice and maintained growth plans.
Documented roadmap boundaries and open decisions after each review.
experienceHighlights: Group Product Manager for the developer platform of a SaaS company since 2022, managing the platform's three product managers; product manager and senior product manager on the same company's API products from 2016 to 2022; nine years of product management in all, three years of them managing product managers.
Owner of the pricing and packaging of the platform's API tiers with the commercial team, with the two tier changes of 2023 and 2024 approved on pricing proposals under my name.
Set the platform roadmap with the product director each half-year and ran the quarterly roadmap review with engineering leadership, with the review decks and decision logs in the product folder.
Coached the three product managers under the product group's coaching practice, with the coaching notes and the growth plans filed with the product director.
Wrote the roadmap boundary section of each half-year roadmap and the open decisions list after each quarterly review.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Approved pricing proposal for 2023 tier change
Approved pricing proposal for 2024 tier change
Quarterly roadmap review deck with decision log
Growth plan for each product manager
